recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed unless Pharmacy later changes the modern CodeableReference medication pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-7473 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It requested permitting a code for MedicationStatement.medication as an alternative to a full Medication resource, with the accepted resolution extending code-or-resource support to medicationPrescription, medicationStatement, medicationAdministration, and medicationDispense.
initial_application: No current git commit message explicitly mentions FHIR-7473 or FHIR-7995. Jira comments say the change was already done, and 2015 medication spreadsheet history shows medicationCodeableConcept/code search support being added near medicationReference handling.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is now MedicationRequest. source/fhir.ini actively includes MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement. Current StructureDefinition XML uses CodeableReference with targetProfile Medication for each requested medication element. FHIR-7995 is a duplicate-family issue with the same resolution, and FHIR-38682 later restored MedicationStatement without changing scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies the accepted code-or-resource semantics through CodeableReference(Medication) on all four resources named in the resolution.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7995 was approved as a duplicate of this same medication code-or-resource change family.
Restored MedicationStatement after the MedicationUsage rename and confirmed the scope had not changed.
